editorial:
Imagine being a regular high school senior and suddenly seeing weird lights over your hometown. That is exactly what happens to Alex, and things go from zero to sixty real quick. After the encounter, she starts developing these wild supernatural powers that she cannot control. She teams up with her old friend Sean to figure out what is going on, but the government is already on their tail. It feels like a classic chase movie where the stakes keep getting higher, and you really feel for the characters as they try to stay one step ahead of the bad guys.

The acting is surprisingly solid and makes you actually care if these kids get caught. While some parts of the plot feel a bit slow, the action scenes make up for it and keep you on the edge of your seat. If you like sci-fi stories about people discovering secret powers, you will love this one.
endingExplained: In the final act, Alex realizes her powers are linked to an alien signal. The government tries to capture her to weaponize her abilities, but Sean helps her fight back. In a big showdown, Alex fully embraces her powers to disable the agents' tech and escape. The movie wraps up with Alex and Sean going on the run, knowing they can never go back to their normal lives but feeling free for the first time.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about secret powers and government conspiracies.
